  function renderPlacementTrack(done=7,animateLatest=false){
    const track=document.querySelector("#placementTrack");
    if(!track)return;
    let html="";
    for(let i=1;i<=15;i++){
      if(i>1){
        const connectorClass=i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)?"done":(animateLatest&&i===done?"arriving":"");
        html += `<span class="placement-connector ${connectorClass}"></span>`;
      }
      const nodeClass=i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)?"done":(animateLatest&&i===done?"arriving":"");
      const check=(i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)||i===done)?`<b>✓</b>`:"";
      html += `<span class="placement-node ${nodeClass}">${check}</span>`;
    }
    track.innerHTML=html;
  }

  async function invoke(name, body, jwt) {
    const headers = jwt ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${jwt}` } : {};
    const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/${name}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', apikey: SUPABASE_KEY, ...headers },
      body: JSON.stringify(body || {}),
    });
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `Request failed (${res.status})`);
    return data;
  }

  async function persistSession(session) {
    if (!session) return;
    const { error } = await client.auth.setSession({ access_token: session.access_token, refresh_token: session.refresh_token });
    if (error) throw error;
  }

  async function rpc(name, args = {}) {
    const { data, error } = await client.rpc(name, args);
    if (error) throw error;
    return data;
  }

  async function signUp(username, password) { const data = await invoke('hub-signup', { username, password }); await persistSession(data.session); return data; }

    if(reqList)reqList.innerHTML=friendRequests.length?friendRequests.map(name=>playerSocialRow(name,`<button class="social-accept" type="button" data-friend-accept="${name}" aria-label="${t("social.accept")}">✓</button><button class="social-decline" type="button" data-friend-decline="${name}" aria-label="${t("social.decline")}">×</button>`)).join(""):`<p class="empty-social">${t("social.noRequests")}</p>`;
    if(inviteList){
      const pending=cupInvites.filter(x=>x.status==="pending");
      inviteList.innerHTML=pending.length?pending.map(inv=>{
        const locked=!!joinedCup;
        return `<article class="cup-invite-card"><div class="cup-invite-player">${playerSocialRow(inv.from)}</div><div class="cup-invite-copy"><strong>${inv.cup}</strong><span>${inv.mode} · ${inv.from} ${t("social.invitedBy")}</span></div><div class="cup-invite-actions"><button class="social-accept wide-social" type="button" data-cup-accept="${inv.from}" ${locked?"disabled":""}>${locked?t("social.alreadyJoined"):t("social.accept")}</button><button class="social-decline wide-social" type="button" data-cup-decline="${inv.from}">${t("social.decline")}</button></div></article>`;
      }).join(""):`<p class="empty-social">${joinedCup?`${t("social.teamConfirmed")}: ${joinedCup}`:t("social.noInvites")}</p>`;
    }
    const fr=document.querySelector("#friendRequestCount");if(fr){fr.textContent=friendRequests.length||"";fr.hidden=!friendRequests.length;}
    const ci=document.querySelector("#cupInviteCount"), pendingCup=cupInvites.filter(x=>x.status==="pending").length;if(ci){ci.textContent=pendingCup||"";ci.hidden=!pendingCup;}
    const dot=document.querySelector("#communityNoticeDot");if(dot)dot.hidden=!(friendRequests.length||pendingCup);
    renderMateOptions();
  }
  function renderMateOptions(){
    const select=document.querySelector("#mateSelect");if(!select)return;
    const others=PLAYERS.map(p=>p.name).filter(n=>n!==state.ownPlayer&&!friends.includes(n));
    const current=select.value;
    select.innerHTML=`<option value="">${state.lang==="de"?"Mitspieler auswählen …":state.lang==="fr"?"Choisir un coéquipier …":"Select mate …"}</option><optgroup label="${t("social.friends")}">${friends.map(n=>`<option value="${n}">${n}</option>`).join("")}</optgroup><optgroup label="${state.lang==="de"?"Andere Spieler":state.lang==="fr"?"Autres joueurs":"Other players"}">${others.map(n=>`<option value="${n}">${n}</option>`).join("")}</optgroup>`;
    if([...select.options].some(o=>o.value===current))select.value=current;
    select.disabled=!!joinedCup;

  }

  }

<script>
window.HubAPI = (() => {
  const SUPABASE_URL = 'https://nxzrgbpaxukgjyzwupjp.supabase.co';
  const SUPABASE_KEY = 'sb_publishable_TawTg_9H-hw2TDWFyHH3ow_PTPPfoND';
  const client = window.supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);

  async function invoke(name, body, jwt) {
    const headers = jwt ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${jwt}` } : {};
    const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/${name}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', apikey: SUPABASE_KEY, ...headers },
      body: JSON.stringify(body || {}),
    });
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `Request failed (${res.status})`);
    return data;
  }

  async function persistSession(session) {
    if (!session) return;
    const { error } = await client.auth.setSession({ access_token: session.access_token, refresh_token: session.refresh_token });
    if (error) throw error;
  }

  async function rpc(name, args = {}) {
    const { data, error } = await client.rpc(name, args);
    if (error) throw error;
    return data;
  }

  async function signUp(username, password) { const data = await invoke('hub-signup', { username, password }); await persistSession(data.session); return data; }
  async function login(username, password) { const data = await invoke('hub-login', { username, password }); await persistSession(data.session); return data; }
  async function logout() { const { error } = await client.auth.signOut(); if (error) throw error; }
  async function currentSession() { const { data, error } = await client.auth.getSession(); if (error) throw error; return data.session; }
  async function currentPlayerId() { return rpc('my_global_player_id'); }

  async function getPlayer(playerId) { const { data, error } = await client.from('player_directory').select('*').eq('id', playerId).single(); if (error) throw error; return data; }
  async function getMyProfile() { return rpc('get_my_profile'); }
  async function getCareerStatsFor(playerId) { const { data, error } = await client.from('player_career_stats').select('*').eq('global_player_id', playerId).maybeSingle(); if (error) throw error; return data; }
  async function getRatingHistory(playerId) { const { data,error }=await client.from('rating_history').select('*').eq('global_player_id',playerId).order('created_at',{ascending:true}); if(error)throw error; return data||[]; }
  async function getMyCompetitiveHistory() { const data=await rpc('get_my_competitive_history'); return data||[]; }
  async function getCompetitiveHistoryForPlayer(playerId) { const data=await rpc('get_competitive_history_for_player',{p_player_id:playerId}); return data||[]; }
  async function getGlobalPlayers() { const { data, error } = await client.from('player_directory').select('*').order('rating', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false }); if (error) throw error; return data || []; }
  async function adminGetGlobalPlayers() { const data=await rpc('admin_get_global_players'); return data||[]; }
  async function adminGetAccountPlayers() { const data=await rpc('admin_get_account_players'); return data||[]; }
  async function searchPlayers(query) { const q=String(query||'').trim(); if(!q)return []; const { data,error }=await client.from('player_directory').select('*').ilike('current_name',`%${q.replace(/[%_]/g,'\\$&')}%`).limit(12); if(error)throw error; return data||[]; }

  async function changePassword(currentPassword, newPassword, repeatPassword) {
    const session = await currentSession(); if (!session) throw new Error('Login required');
    return invoke('hub-change-password', { current_password: currentPassword, new_password: newPassword, new_password_repeat: repeatPassword }, session.access_token);

  async function getCupData(tournamentId) {
    const [teamsRes, playersRes, eventsRes] = await Promise.all([
      client.from('teams').select('*').eq('tournament_id', tournamentId).order('created_at'),
      client.from('players').select('*').eq('tournament_id', tournamentId).order('created_at'),
      client.from('events').select('*').in('player_id', (await client.from('players').select('id').eq('tournament_id', tournamentId)).data?.map(x=>x.id)||['00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000']).order('round').order('created_at'),
    ]);
    if (teamsRes.error) throw teamsRes.error; if (playersRes.error) throw playersRes.error; if (eventsRes.error) throw eventsRes.error;
    return { teams: teamsRes.data||[], players: playersRes.data||[], events: eventsRes.data||[] };
  }

  function defaultPublicCup(){
    const cups=real.cups||[];if(!cups.length)return null;
    const liveCup=cups.find(c=>c.status==='live');if(liveCup)return liveCup;
    const now=Date.now(),dated=cups.map(c=>({c,t:cupStartMs(c)})).filter(x=>x.t!==null);
    const future=dated.filter(x=>x.t>=now&&x.c.status!=='finished').sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t)[0]?.c;
    if(future)return future;
    return dated.filter(x=>x.t<now).sort((a,b)=>b.t-a.t)[0]?.c||cups[0]||null;
  }

  function statsForPlayer(player,data,round=Infinity){const ev=data.events.filter(e=>e.player_id===player.id&&e.round<=round);let k=0,dm=0,w=0;for(const e of ev){if(e.type==='kill')k++;if(e.type==='deathmatch')dm++;if(e.type==='win')w++;}return {k,dm,w,points:k+dm*3+w*2};}
  function competitionRanks(entries,getPoints){let prev=null,rank=0;return entries.sort((a,b)=>getPoints(b)-getPoints(a)).map((x,i)=>{const p=getPoints(x);if(i===0||p!==prev)rank=i+1;prev=p;return {x,rank,points:p};});}
  function playerAvatarFromCup(p,cls='cup-list-avatar pixel-avatar'){const gp=gpById(p.global_player_id);return avatarImg(gp||{current_name:p.name},cls);}
  function roundStatsForPlayer(player,data,round){const now=statsForPlayer(player,data,round),prev=statsForPlayer(player,data,round-1);return {k:now.k-prev.k,dm:now.dm-prev.dm,w:now.w-prev.w,points:now.points-prev.points};}
  function cupDeaths(player,cup,data){const s=statsForPlayer(player,data);return Math.max(0,Number(cup.current_round||0)-s.w);}
  function maxRoundPoints(player,cup,data){let m=0;for(let r=1;r<=Number(cup.current_round||0);r++)m=Math.max(m,roundStatsForPlayer(player,data,r).points);return m;}

    const future=dated.filter(x=>x.t>=now&&x.c.status!=='finished').sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t)[0]?.c;
    if(future)return future;
    return dated.filter(x=>x.t<now).sort((a,b)=>b.t-a.t)[0]?.c||cups[0]||null;
  }

  function formatDate(v){if(!v)return '—';try{return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(document.documentElement.lang||'en',{dateStyle:'medium',timeStyle:'short'}).format(new Date(v));}catch{return v;}}
  async function cupData(id,force=false){if(!force&&real.cupCache.has(id))return real.cupCache.get(id);const data=await api.getCupData(id);real.cupCache.set(id,data);return data;}
  function statsForPlayer(player,data,round=Infinity){const ev=data.events.filter(e=>e.player_id===player.id&&e.round<=round);let k=0,dm=0,w=0;for(const e of ev){if(e.type==='kill')k++;if(e.type==='deathmatch')dm++;if(e.type==='win')w++;}return {k,dm,w,points:k+dm*3+w*2};}
  function competitionRanks(entries,getPoints){let prev=null,rank=0;return entries.sort((a,b)=>getPoints(b)-getPoints(a)).map((x,i)=>{const p=getPoints(x);if(i===0||p!==prev)rank=i+1;prev=p;return {x,rank,points:p};});}
  function playerAvatarFromCup(p,cls='cup-list-avatar pixel-avatar'){const gp=gpById(p.global_player_id);return avatarImg(gp||{current_name:p.name},cls);}
  function roundStatsForPlayer(player,data,round){const now=statsForPlayer(player,data,round),prev=statsForPlayer(player,data,round-1);return {k:now.k-prev.k,dm:now.dm-prev.dm,w:now.w-prev.w,points:now.points-prev.points};}
  function cupDeaths(player,cup,data){const s=statsForPlayer(player,data);return Math.max(0,Number(cup.current_round||0)-s.w);}
  function maxRoundPoints(player,cup,data){let m=0;for(let r=1;r<=Number(cup.current_round||0);r++)m=Math.max(m,roundStatsForPlayer(player,data,r).points);return m;}

  function renderPlacementTrack(done=7,animateLatest=false){
    const track=document.querySelector("#placementTrack");
    if(!track)return;
    let html="";
    for(let i=1;i<=15;i++){
      if(i>1){
        const connectorClass=i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)?"done":(animateLatest&&i===done?"arriving":"");
        html += `<span class="placement-connector ${connectorClass}"></span>`;
      }
      const nodeClass=i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)?"done":(animateLatest&&i===done?"arriving":"");
      const check=(i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)||i===done)?`<b>✓</b>`:"";
      html += `<span class="placement-node ${nodeClass}">${check}</span>`;
    }

  async function invoke(name, body, jwt) {
    const headers = jwt ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${jwt}` } : {};
    const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/${name}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', apikey: SUPABASE_KEY, ...headers },
      body: JSON.stringify(body || {}),
    });
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `Request failed (${res.status})`);
    return data;
  }

  async function persistSession(session) {
    if (!session) return;
    const { error } = await client.auth.setSession({ access_token: session.access_token, refresh_token: session.refresh_token });
    if (error) throw error;
  }

  async function rpc(name, args = {}) {
    const { data, error } = await client.rpc(name, args);
    if (error) throw error;
    return data;
  }

    const ext=(file.name?.split('.').pop()||'png').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'')||'png';
    const path=`cup-icons/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${ext}`;
    const { error }=await client.storage.from('hub-assets').upload(path,file,{cacheControl:'3600',upsert:false});
    if(error)throw error;
    return client.storage.from('hub-assets').getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl;
  }

  function ratingBand(r){
    const x=Number(r);
    if(x>=2000)return {low:2000,high:3000,key:'grandmaster'};
    if(x>=1750)return {low:1750,high:2000,key:'master'};
    if(x>=1500)return {low:1500,high:1750,key:'diamond'};
    if(x>=1250)return {low:1250,high:1500,key:'emerald'};
    if(x>=1000)return {low:1000,high:1250,key:'gold'};
    if(x>=750)return {low:750,high:1000,key:'iron'};
    return {low:0,high:750,key:'wood'};
  }
  function buildRankJourney(before,after){
    before=Number(before);after=Number(after);
    if(!Number.isFinite(before)||!Number.isFinite(after))return [];
    if(Math.abs(after-before)<.001)return [{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
    const out=[];let v=before;const up=after>before;let guard=0;
    while((up?v<after-.001:v>after+.001)&&guard++<12){
      const b=ratingBand(v);
      if(up){
        if(after<b.high){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.max(v, b.high-.01);
        if(edge>v+.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=b.high;
        if(Math.abs(after-v)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(v);out.push({before:v,after:v,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }else{
        if(after>=b.low){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.min(v,b.low+.01);
        if(edge<v-.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=Math.max(0,b.low-.01);
        if(Math.abs(after-b.low)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(after);out.push({before:after,after,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }
    }
    return out.length?out:[{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
  }

  function ratingBand(r){
    const x=Number(r);
    if(x>=2000)return {low:2000,high:3000,key:'grandmaster'};
    if(x>=1750)return {low:1750,high:2000,key:'master'};
    if(x>=1500)return {low:1500,high:1750,key:'diamond'};
    if(x>=1250)return {low:1250,high:1500,key:'emerald'};
    if(x>=1000)return {low:1000,high:1250,key:'gold'};
    if(x>=750)return {low:750,high:1000,key:'iron'};
    return {low:0,high:750,key:'wood'};
  }
  function buildRankJourney(before,after){
    before=Number(before);after=Number(after);
    if(!Number.isFinite(before)||!Number.isFinite(after))return [];
    if(Math.abs(after-before)<.001)return [{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
    const out=[];let v=before;const up=after>before;let guard=0;
    while((up?v<after-.001:v>after+.001)&&guard++<12){
      const b=ratingBand(v);
      if(up){
        if(after<b.high){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.max(v, b.high-.01);
        if(edge>v+.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=b.high;
        if(Math.abs(after-v)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(v);out.push({before:v,after:v,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }else{
        if(after>=b.low){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.min(v,b.low+.01);
        if(edge<v-.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=Math.max(0,b.low-.01);
        if(Math.abs(after-b.low)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(after);out.push({before:after,after,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }
    }
    return out.length?out:[{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
  }

  async function runMissedCompetitiveCatchup(){
    if(catchupBusy||document.hidden||!live.session||!live.player)return;
    let st;try{st=await api.getMyAnimationState();}catch(e){console.warn('Catch-up state failed',e);return;}if(!st)return;
    const curGames=Number(st.current_finalized_games||0),seenGames=Number(st.seen_finalized_games||0),curPlacement=Number(st.current_placement_games||0),seenPlacement=Number(st.seen_placement_games||0),curRanked=!!st.current_is_ranked,seenRanked=!!st.seen_is_ranked;

    const missedGames=Math.max(1,curGames-seenGames),speed=missedGames===1?1:missedGames<=3?1.75:missedGames<=6?2.5:3;
    catchupTarget={...st,missedGames,speed};catchupFinalShown=false;catchupBusy=true;const token=++catchupToken;
    try{
      if(!seenRanked){
        const last=Math.min(15,curPlacement);
        if(last>seenPlacement){
          for(let done=seenPlacement+1;done<=last;done++){
            if(token!==catchupToken||document.hidden)return;const completed=done===15&&curRanked;
            window.simulatePlacementRatingEvent?.({done,completed,rating:completed?Number(st.current_rating):null,rankAfter:completed&&Number.isFinite(Number(st.current_rating))?ratingBand(Number(st.current_rating)).key:null,catchup:true,speed});
            await sleep((completed?6200:3400)/speed);
          }
        }else if(curRanked){window.simulatePlacementRatingEvent?.({done:15,completed:true,rating:Number(st.current_rating),rankAfter:ratingBand(Number(st.current_rating)).key,catchup:true,speed});await sleep(6200/speed);}
      }else if(curRanked){
        const journey=buildRankJourney(Number(st.seen_rating),Number(st.current_rating));
        for(const seg of journey){if(token!==catchupToken||document.hidden)return;window.simulateRealtimeRatingEvent?.({...seg,catchup:true,speed});await sleep(4100/speed);}
      }else{await ackCompetitiveState();return;}
      if(token===catchupToken){catchupFinalShown=true;await ackCompetitiveState();}
    }finally{if(token===catchupToken)catchupBusy=false;}
  }

  }

    });
  }

  function ratingBand(r){
    const x=Number(r);
    if(x>=2000)return {low:2000,high:3000,key:'grandmaster'};
    if(x>=1750)return {low:1750,high:2000,key:'master'};
    if(x>=1500)return {low:1500,high:1750,key:'diamond'};
    if(x>=1250)return {low:1250,high:1500,key:'emerald'};
    if(x>=1000)return {low:1000,high:1250,key:'gold'};
    if(x>=750)return {low:750,high:1000,key:'iron'};
    return {low:0,high:750,key:'wood'};
  }
  function buildRankJourney(before,after){
    before=Number(before);after=Number(after);
    if(!Number.isFinite(before)||!Number.isFinite(after))return [];
    if(Math.abs(after-before)<.001)return [{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
    const out=[];let v=before;const up=after>before;let guard=0;
    while((up?v<after-.001:v>after+.001)&&guard++<12){
      const b=ratingBand(v);
      if(up){
        if(after<b.high){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.max(v, b.high-.01);
        if(edge>v+.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=b.high;
        if(Math.abs(after-v)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(v);out.push({before:v,after:v,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }else{
        if(after>=b.low){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.min(v,b.low+.01);
        if(edge<v-.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=Math.max(0,b.low-.01);
        if(Math.abs(after-b.low)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(after);out.push({before:after,after,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }
    }
    return out.length?out:[{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
  }

  async function runMissedCompetitiveCatchup(){
    if(catchupBusy||document.hidden||!live.session||!live.player)return;
    let st;try{st=await api.getMyAnimationState();}catch(e){console.warn('Catch-up state failed',e);return;}if(!st)return;
    const curGames=Number(st.current_finalized_games||0),seenGames=Number(st.seen_finalized_games||0),curPlacement=Number(st.current_placement_games||0),seenPlacement=Number(st.seen_placement_games||0),curRanked=!!st.current_is_ranked,seenRanked=!!st.seen_is_ranked;
    if(curGames<=seenGames){const drift=curGames!==seenGames||curPlacement!==seenPlacement||curRanked!==seenRanked||(curRanked&&seenRanked&&Math.abs(Number(st.current_rating||0)-Number(st.seen_rating||0))>.001);if(drift)await ackCompetitiveState();return;}
    if(live.player.ranking_experience_enabled===false){await ackCompetitiveState();return;}
    const missedGames=Math.max(1,curGames-seenGames),speed=missedGames===1?1:missedGames<=3?1.75:missedGames<=6?2.5:3;
    catchupTarget={...st,missedGames,speed};catchupFinalShown=false;catchupBusy=true;const token=++catchupToken;
    try{
      if(!seenRanked){
        const last=Math.min(15,curPlacement);
        if(last>seenPlacement){
          for(let done=seenPlacement+1;done<=last;done++){
            if(token!==catchupToken||document.hidden)return;const completed=done===15&&curRanked;
            window.simulatePlacementRatingEvent?.({done,completed,rating:completed?Number(st.current_rating):null,rankAfter:completed&&Number.isFinite(Number(st.current_rating))?ratingBand(Number(st.current_rating)).key:null,catchup:true,speed});
            await sleep((completed?6200:3400)/speed);
          }
        }else if(curRanked){window.simulatePlacementRatingEvent?.({done:15,completed:true,rating:Number(st.current_rating),rankAfter:ratingBand(Number(st.current_rating)).key,catchup:true,speed});await sleep(6200/speed);}
      }else if(curRanked){
        const journey=buildRankJourney(Number(st.seen_rating),Number(st.current_rating));
        for(const seg of journey){if(token!==catchupToken||document.hidden)return;window.simulateRealtimeRatingEvent?.({...seg,catchup:true,speed});await sleep(4100/speed);}
      }else{await ackCompetitiveState();return;}
      if(token===catchupToken){catchupFinalShown=true;await ackCompetitiveState();}
    }finally{if(token===catchupToken)catchupBusy=false;}
  }

  function showCatchupFinalInstant(){
    const st=catchupTarget;if(!st)return false;const speed=Number(st.speed||1);catchupToken++;catchupFinalShown=true;

    }

  }

  function openRankingChoice(firstTime=false) {
    if(!live.player) return;
    const enabled=live.player.ranking_experience_enabled===true;
    const m=modalShell('v3RankingChoice',`<section class="v3-modal v3-ranking-choice"><span class="eyebrow">CROSS-CUP RANKING</span><h2>${firstTime?copy('Do you want to take part in the cross-Cup ranking experience?','Möchtest du an der Cup-übergreifenden Ranglisten-Erfahrung teilnehmen?','Veux-tu afficher le classement inter-Cups ?'):(enabled?copy('Hide ranked experience?','Ranglisten-Modus ausblenden?','Masquer le mode classé ?'):copy('Enable ranked experience?','Ranglisten-Modus aktivieren?','Activer le mode classé ?'))}</h2><p>${copy('Your rating is calculated either way. This setting only decides whether you can see ranks, rating changes, statistics and the cross-Cup ranking.','Dein Rating wird in jedem Fall berechnet. Diese Einstellung entscheidet nur, ob du Ränge, Rating-Änderungen, Statistiken und die Cup-übergreifende Rangliste sehen kannst.','Ton rating est calculé dans tous les cas. Ce réglage contrôle uniquement l’affichage du classement, des rangs et des statistiques.')}</p><div class="v3-choice-actions"><button class="ghost-button wide" id="v3RankingNo">${firstTime?copy('No, hide it','Nein, ausblenden','Non, masquer'):copy('Cancel','Abbrechen','Annuler')}</button><button class="cta-button wide" id="v3RankingYes">${firstTime?copy('Yes, show ranking','Ja, Ranking anzeigen','Oui, afficher'):enabled?copy('Yes, hide ranking','Ja, Ranking ausblenden','Oui, masquer'):copy('Yes, enable ranking','Ja, Ranking aktivieren','Oui, activer')}</button></div></section>`);
    $('#v3RankingNo',m).onclick=async()=>{
      if(firstTime){await setRanking(false);m.remove();setPage('cup');} else m.remove();
    };
    $('#v3RankingYes',m).onclick=async()=>{await setRanking(firstTime?true:!enabled);m.remove(); if(!live.player.ranking_experience_enabled)setPage('cup');};
  }

  async function setRanking(enabled) {
    try { await api.setRankingExperience(enabled); live.player.ranking_experience_enabled=enabled; applyRankingVisibility(); if(enabled) await syncOwnProfileToUi(); toast(enabled?copy('Ranked experience enabled.','Ranglisten-Modus aktiviert.','Mode classé activé.'):copy('Ranked experience hidden. Rating still continues in the background.','Ranglisten-Modus ausgeblendet. Das Rating läuft im Hintergrund weiter.','Mode classé masqué. Le rating continue en arrière-plan.')); }
    catch(err){toast(err.message||String(err),true);}
  }

  function addRankingPreferenceButton() {
    let b=$('#v3RankingPreference');
    if(!live.session || !live.player){b?.remove();return;}
    if(!b){b=document.createElement('button');b.id='v3RankingPreference';b.type='button';b.className='ghost-button';$('.profile-actions')?.prepend(b);b.onclick=()=>openRankingChoice(false);}
    b.textContent=live.player.ranking_experience_enabled===false?copy("I'm interested in ranked mode after all","Ich bin doch am Ranglisten-Modus interessiert","Je veux finalement voir le mode classé"):copy("I don't want to see ranked mode","Ich will den Ranglisten-Modus nicht mehr sehen","Je ne veux plus voir le mode classé");
  }

  function applyRankingVisibility() {

    });
  }

  function ratingBand(r){
    const x=Number(r);
    if(x>=2000)return {low:2000,high:3000,key:'grandmaster'};
    if(x>=1750)return {low:1750,high:2000,key:'master'};
    if(x>=1500)return {low:1500,high:1750,key:'diamond'};
    if(x>=1250)return {low:1250,high:1500,key:'emerald'};
    if(x>=1000)return {low:1000,high:1250,key:'gold'};
    if(x>=750)return {low:750,high:1000,key:'iron'};
    return {low:0,high:750,key:'wood'};
  }
  function buildRankJourney(before,after){
    before=Number(before);after=Number(after);
    if(!Number.isFinite(before)||!Number.isFinite(after))return [];
    if(Math.abs(after-before)<.001)return [{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
    const out=[];let v=before;const up=after>before;let guard=0;
    while((up?v<after-.001:v>after+.001)&&guard++<12){
      const b=ratingBand(v);
      if(up){
        if(after<b.high){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.max(v, b.high-.01);
        if(edge>v+.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=b.high;
        if(Math.abs(after-v)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(v);out.push({before:v,after:v,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }else{
        if(after>=b.low){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.min(v,b.low+.01);
        if(edge<v-.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=Math.max(0,b.low-.01);
        if(Math.abs(after-b.low)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(after);out.push({before:after,after,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }
    }
    return out.length?out:[{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
  }

  async function runMissedCompetitiveCatchup(){
    if(catchupBusy||document.hidden||!live.session||!live.player)return;
    let st;try{st=await api.getMyAnimationState();}catch(e){console.warn('Catch-up state failed',e);return;}if(!st)return;
    const curGames=Number(st.current_finalized_games||0),seenGames=Number(st.seen_finalized_games||0),curPlacement=Number(st.current_placement_games||0),seenPlacement=Number(st.seen_placement_games||0),curRanked=!!st.current_is_ranked,seenRanked=!!st.seen_is_ranked;
    if(curGames<=seenGames){const drift=curGames!==seenGames||curPlacement!==seenPlacement||curRanked!==seenRanked||(curRanked&&seenRanked&&Math.abs(Number(st.current_rating||0)-Number(st.seen_rating||0))>.001);if(drift)await ackCompetitiveState();return;}
    if(live.player.ranking_experience_enabled===false){await ackCompetitiveState();return;}
    const missedGames=Math.max(1,curGames-seenGames),speed=missedGames===1?1:missedGames<=3?1.75:missedGames<=6?2.5:3;
    catchupTarget={...st,missedGames,speed};catchupFinalShown=false;catchupBusy=true;const token=++catchupToken;
    try{
      if(!seenRanked){
        const last=Math.min(15,curPlacement);
        if(last>seenPlacement){
          for(let done=seenPlacement+1;done<=last;done++){
            if(token!==catchupToken||document.hidden)return;const completed=done===15&&curRanked;
            window.simulatePlacementRatingEvent?.({done,completed,rating:completed?Number(st.current_rating):null,rankAfter:completed&&Number.isFinite(Number(st.current_rating))?ratingBand(Number(st.current_rating)).key:null,catchup:true,speed});
            await sleep((completed?6200:3400)/speed);
          }
        }else if(curRanked){window.simulatePlacementRatingEvent?.({done:15,completed:true,rating:Number(st.current_rating),rankAfter:ratingBand(Number(st.current_rating)).key,catchup:true,speed});await sleep(6200/speed);}
      }else if(curRanked){
        const journey=buildRankJourney(Number(st.seen_rating),Number(st.current_rating));
        for(const seg of journey){if(token!==catchupToken||document.hidden)return;window.simulateRealtimeRatingEvent?.({...seg,catchup:true,speed});await sleep(4100/speed);}
      }else{await ackCompetitiveState();return;}
      if(token===catchupToken){catchupFinalShown=true;await ackCompetitiveState();}
    }finally{if(token===catchupToken)catchupBusy=false;}
  }

  function showCatchupFinalInstant(){
    const st=catchupTarget;if(!st)return false;const speed=Number(st.speed||1);catchupToken++;catchupFinalShown=true;
    if(!st.seen_is_ranked){

    }
    ackCompetitiveState();return true;
  }

  async function openOwnProfile(){
    if(!live.session)return openAuth('login');
    const name=live.player?.current_name||state.ownPlayer;
    if(!name)return;
    state.ownPlayer=name;state.profilePlayer=name;
    const renderLive=window.HubV3?.renderProfileLive;
    if(typeof renderLive==='function') await renderLive(name);
    else await syncOwnProfileToUi();
    setPage('profile');
  }

  async function refreshForeignProfile(name){
    if(!live.player)return;
    const gp=live.globalPlayers.find(p=>p.current_name===name);if(!gp)return;
    cacheAvatar(gp);
    const av=$('#profileAvatar');if(av){if(gp.avatar_pixels)av.src=pixelDataUrl(gp.avatar_pixels);av.hidden=false;}
    if($('#profilePlayerName'))$('#profilePlayerName').textContent=gp.current_name;
    $('#editAvatarButton')?.setAttribute('hidden','');$('#renameButton')?.setAttribute('hidden','');
    if(live.player.ranking_experience_enabled===false)return;
    if(gp.is_ranked){if($('#profileRating'))$('#profileRating').textContent=Math.round(Number(gp.rating));if($('#profileRankName'))$('#profileRankName').textContent=rankLabel(rankKey(Number(gp.rating)));}
  }

  function rankKey(r){return r>=2000?'grandmaster':r>=1750?'master':r>=1500?'diamond':r>=1250?'emerald':r>=1000?'gold':r>=750?'iron':'wood';}
  function rankLabel(k){return ({wood:'Wood',iron:'Iron',gold:'Gold',emerald:'Emerald',diamond:'Diamond',master:'Master',grandmaster:'Grandmaster'})[k]||k;}

  async function updateRegistrationButton(){
    try{live.tournaments=await api.getTournaments();const open=live.tournaments.some(t=>t.status==='registration');const top=$('.next-cup-cta');if(top)top.hidden=!open;}catch(_){const top=$('.next-cup-cta');if(top)top.hidden=true;}
  }

  function updateHeader(){
    const b=$('#loginDemoButton');if(!b)return;
    b.removeAttribute('data-i18n');
    b.textContent=live.session&&live.player?live.player.current_name:copy('Log in','Anmelden','Se connecter');
    b.classList.toggle('is-account',!!live.session);

  }

  async function restoreAuth(showChoice=false){
    try{
      live.session=await api.currentSession();
      if(!live.session){live.player=null;live.stats=null;live.isAdmin=false;document.body.classList.remove('ranking-experience-hidden');updateHeader();addRankingPreferenceButton();document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hub:auth-restored',{detail:{loggedIn:false}}));return;}
      const id=await api.currentPlayerId();
      let registrationState=null;
      if(!id){
        try{
          const {data}=await api.client.rpc('get_my_registration_status');
          registrationState=data||null;
        }catch(_pendingStateError){}
      }
      live.registrationState=registrationState;
      live.player=id?await api.getMyProfile():null;
      live.stats=id?await api.getCareerStatsFor(id):null;
      const {data:isAdmin}=await api.client.rpc('is_admin');live.isAdmin=!!isAdmin;
      live.globalPlayers=await api.getGlobalPlayers();
      if(live.player){ensureDemoPlayer(live.player);cacheAvatar(live.player);state.ownPlayer=live.player.current_name;}
      updateHeader();applyRankingVisibility();await updateRegistrationButton();
      if(live.player && live.player.ranking_experience_enabled===null && !document.getElementById('v3RankingChoice')) openRankingChoice(true);
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hub:auth-restored',{detail:{loggedIn:!!live.session,player:live.player,pending:registrationState?.status==='pending',registrationState}}));
    }catch(err){console.error('HUB auth restore failed',err);live.session=null;live.player=null;updateHeader();document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hub:auth-restored',{detail:{loggedIn:false,error:true}}));}
  }

  function pixelsFromEditor(){
    return $$('#avatarPixelGrid .avatar-pixel, #avatarPixelGrid .pixel-cell').map(cell=>{
      const c=cell.style.backgroundColor||'#ffffff';
      if(c.startsWith('#'))return c.toUpperCase();
      const m=c.match(/\d+/g);if(!m)return '#FFFFFF';return '#'+m.slice(0,3).map(n=>(+n).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('').toUpperCase();
    });
  }

  function escapeHtml(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
  function escapeAttr(s){return escapeHtml(s);}

  });

  function ratingBand(r){
    const x=Number(r);
    if(x>=2000)return {low:2000,high:3000,key:'grandmaster'};
    if(x>=1750)return {low:1750,high:2000,key:'master'};
    if(x>=1500)return {low:1500,high:1750,key:'diamond'};
    if(x>=1250)return {low:1250,high:1500,key:'emerald'};
    if(x>=1000)return {low:1000,high:1250,key:'gold'};
    if(x>=750)return {low:750,high:1000,key:'iron'};
    return {low:0,high:750,key:'wood'};
  }
  function buildRankJourney(before,after){
    before=Number(before);after=Number(after);
    if(!Number.isFinite(before)||!Number.isFinite(after))return [];
    if(Math.abs(after-before)<.001)return [{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
    const out=[];let v=before;const up=after>before;let guard=0;
    while((up?v<after-.001:v>after+.001)&&guard++<12){
      const b=ratingBand(v);
      if(up){
        if(after<b.high){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.max(v, b.high-.01);
        if(edge>v+.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=b.high;
        if(Math.abs(after-v)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(v);out.push({before:v,after:v,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }else{
        if(after>=b.low){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.min(v,b.low+.01);
        if(edge<v-.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=Math.max(0,b.low-.01);
        if(Math.abs(after-b.low)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(after);out.push({before:after,after,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }
    }
    return out.length?out:[{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
  }

  async function runMissedCompetitiveCatchup(){
    if(catchupBusy||document.hidden||!live.session||!live.player)return;
    let st;try{st=await api.getMyAnimationState();}catch(e){console.warn('Catch-up state failed',e);return;}if(!st)return;
    const curGames=Number(st.current_finalized_games||0),seenGames=Number(st.seen_finalized_games||0),curPlacement=Number(st.current_placement_games||0),seenPlacement=Number(st.seen_placement_games||0),curRanked=!!st.current_is_ranked,seenRanked=!!st.seen_is_ranked;

  function pixelsFromEditor(){
    return $$('#avatarPixelGrid .avatar-pixel, #avatarPixelGrid .pixel-cell').map(cell=>{
      const c=cell.style.backgroundColor||'#ffffff';
      if(c.startsWith('#'))return c.toUpperCase();
      const m=c.match(/\d+/g);if(!m)return '#FFFFFF';return '#'+m.slice(0,3).map(n=>(+n).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('').toUpperCase();
    });
  }

  function ratingBand(r){
    const x=Number(r);
    if(x>=2000)return {low:2000,high:3000,key:'grandmaster'};
    if(x>=1750)return {low:1750,high:2000,key:'master'};
    if(x>=1500)return {low:1500,high:1750,key:'diamond'};
    if(x>=1250)return {low:1250,high:1500,key:'emerald'};
    if(x>=1000)return {low:1000,high:1250,key:'gold'};
    if(x>=750)return {low:750,high:1000,key:'iron'};
    return {low:0,high:750,key:'wood'};
  }
  function buildRankJourney(before,after){
    before=Number(before);after=Number(after);
    if(!Number.isFinite(before)||!Number.isFinite(after))return [];
    if(Math.abs(after-before)<.001)return [{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
    const out=[];let v=before;const up=after>before;let guard=0;
    while((up?v<after-.001:v>after+.001)&&guard++<12){
      const b=ratingBand(v);
      if(up){
        if(after<b.high){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.max(v, b.high-.01);
        if(edge>v+.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=b.high;
        if(Math.abs(after-v)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(v);out.push({before:v,after:v,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }else{
        if(after>=b.low){out.push({before:v,after,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});break;}
        const edge=Math.min(v,b.low+.01);
        if(edge<v-.001)out.push({before:v,after:edge,rankBefore:b.key,rankAfter:b.key});
        v=Math.max(0,b.low-.01);
        if(Math.abs(after-b.low)<.001){const nb=ratingBand(after);out.push({before:after,after,rankBefore:nb.key,rankAfter:nb.key});break;}
      }
    }
    return out.length?out:[{before,after,rankBefore:ratingBand(before).key,rankAfter:ratingBand(after).key}];
  }

  function pixelDataUrl(pixels) {
    const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=16;c.height=16;const x=c.getContext('2d');
    (pixels||[]).forEach((color,i)=>{x.fillStyle=color||'#ffffff';x.fillRect(i%16,Math.floor(i/16),1,1);});
    return c.toDataURL('image/png');
  }

  }

function cupStats(name){
  let points=0,kills=0,dm=0,wins=0,maxRound=0;
  for(let r=1;r<=8;r++){ const e=eventFor(r,name); const p=pointsFor(e); points+=p;kills+=e.k;dm+=e.dm;wins+=e.w;maxRound=Math.max(maxRound,p); }
  return {points,kills,dm,wins,deaths:8-wins,maxRound};
}
function careerStats(name){
  const p=playerByName(name), c=cupStats(name), factor=Math.max(1,p.games/8);
  const roundWins=Math.round(c.wins*factor), kills=Math.round(c.kills*factor), deaths=Math.max(0,p.games-roundWins);
  return {
    rankedGames:p.games,cups:Math.max(1,Math.round(p.games/8)),avgPoints:(c.points/8).toFixed(1),
    kills,cupWins:CUP_WIN_DEMO[name]||0,roundWins,kd:(kills/Math.max(1,deaths)).toFixed(2),
    mostCupPoints:c.points,mostRoundPoints:c.maxRound
  };
}

function openRankUpdate(payload={}){
  const legacy=typeof payload==='boolean';
  const before=legacy?(payload?1988:1908):Number(payload.before??payload.ratingBefore);
  const after=legacy?(payload?2015:1935):Number(payload.after??payload.ratingAfter);
  if(!Number.isFinite(before)||!Number.isFinite(after))return;
  const speed=Math.max(1,Number(payload.speed)||1),instant=!!payload.instant;
  const modal=document.querySelector('#roundUpdateModal'),card=document.querySelector('#rankUpdateCard'),icon=document.querySelector('#updateRankIcon'),bar=document.querySelector('#animatedUpdateBar'),message=document.querySelector('#rankUpMessage');
  if(!modal||!card||!icon||!bar||!message)return;
  clearTimeout(openRankUpdate._switchTimer);clearTimeout(openRankUpdate._finishTimer);
  const oldKey=(!legacy&&payload.rankBefore)||getRankKey(before),newKey=(!legacy&&payload.rankAfter)||getRankKey(after);
  const rankChanged=oldKey!==newKey,rankUp=rankChanged&&after>before,oldB=getBounds(before),newB=getBounds(after),beforePct=pct(before,oldB),afterPct=pct(after,newB),delta=after-before;
  const updateMeta=(key,bounds,p)=>{
    icon.src=RANK_ICONS[key];document.querySelector('#updateRankName').textContent=rankName(key);
    document.querySelector('#updateLow').textContent=bounds.low;document.querySelector('#updateHigh').textContent=bounds.high;
    document.querySelector('#updateProgressTitle').textContent=bounds.next?t('overlay.progressTo',{rank:rankName(bounds.next)}):rankName(key);
    document.querySelector('#updateProgressPct').textContent=`${Math.round(p)}%`;
    document.querySelector('#updateRemaining').textContent=t('overlay.left',{n:Math.max(0,Math.round(bounds.high-after))});
  };
  card.style.setProperty('--hub-rank-pulse-duration',`${2.33/speed}s`);card.style.setProperty('--hub-rank-pulse-delay',`${3.67/speed}s`);
  card.style.setProperty('--hub-flare-duration',`${2.5/speed}s`);card.style.setProperty('--hub-flare-delay',`${3.67/speed}s`);
  card.style.setProperty('--hub-icon-duration',`${3/speed}s`);card.style.setProperty('--hub-icon-delay',`${3.42/speed}s`);
  card.classList.remove('rank-up');void card.offsetWidth;if(rankUp&&!instant)card.classList.add('rank-up');message.hidden=true;
  icon.src=RANK_ICONS[oldKey];document.querySelector('#updateRankName').textContent=rankName(oldKey);
  document.querySelector('#ratingBefore').textContent=Math.round(before);document.querySelector('#ratingAfter').textContent=Math.round(after);
  const deltaEl=document.querySelector('#ratingDelta');deltaEl.textContent=`${delta>=0?'+':''}${Math.round(delta)} Rating`;deltaEl.className=`delta ${delta>=0?'positive':'negative'}`;
  const gameNo=Number(payload.gameNumber||0);document.querySelector('#updateKicker').textContent=gameNo?`RANKED UPDATE · GAME ${gameNo}`:'RANKED UPDATE';document.querySelector('#rankUpdateTitle').textContent=t('overlay.yourProgress');
  document.querySelector('#updateLow').textContent=oldB.low;document.querySelector('#updateHigh').textContent=oldB.high;document.querySelector('#updateProgressTitle').textContent=oldB.next?t('overlay.progressTo',{rank:rankName(oldB.next)}):rankName(oldKey);document.querySelector('#updateProgressPct').textContent=`${Math.round(beforePct)}%`;document.querySelector('#updateRemaining').textContent=t('overlay.left',{n:Math.max(0,Math.round(oldB.high-before))});
  const factors=document.querySelector('#rankUpdateCard .factor-grid');if(factors)factors.hidden=true;
  const finish=()=>{
    clearTimeout(openRankUpdate._switchTimer);clearTimeout(openRankUpdate._finishTimer);card.classList.remove('rank-up');
    updateMeta(newKey,newB,afterPct);document.querySelector('#newRankName').textContent=rankName(newKey);message.hidden=!rankUp;
    bar.style.transition='none';bar.style.width=`${afterPct}%`;
    window.HubAnimationUX.final(modal);
  };
  modal.hidden=false;window.HubAnimationUX.begin(modal,finish);
  if(instant){finish();return;}
  bar.style.transition='none';bar.style.width=`${beforePct}%`;
  const firstTarget=rankChanged?(after>before?100:0):afterPct;
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{bar.style.transition=`width ${3.5/speed}s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1)`;bar.style.width=`${firstTarget}%`;document.querySelector('#updateProgressPct').textContent=`${Math.round(firstTarget)}%`;}));
  if(rankChanged){
    openRankUpdate._switchTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
      icon.src=RANK_ICONS[newKey];document.querySelector('#updateRankName').textContent=rankName(newKey);document.querySelector('#newRankName').textContent=rankName(newKey);message.hidden=!rankUp;
      bar.style.transition='none';bar.style.width=after>before?'0%':'100%';document.querySelector('#updateLow').textContent=newB.low;document.querySelector('#updateHigh').textContent=newB.high;document.querySelector('#updateProgressTitle').textContent=newB.next?t('overlay.progressTo',{rank:rankName(newB.next)}):rankName(newKey);document.querySelector('#updateRemaining').textContent=t('overlay.left',{n:Math.max(0,Math.round(newB.high-after))});
      requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{bar.style.transition=`width ${3.5/speed}s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1)`;bar.style.width=`${afterPct}%`;document.querySelector('#updateProgressPct').textContent=`${Math.round(afterPct)}%`;}));
    },3850/speed);
    openRankUpdate._finishTimer=setTimeout(finish,(3850+3500)/speed+80);
  }else openRankUpdate._finishTimer=setTimeout(finish,3500/speed+80);
}

  function hashString(value){
    let h=2166136261;
    for(const ch of value){h^=ch.charCodeAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619);}
    return h>>>0;
  }
  function avatarStorageKey(name){ return `sg-hub-avatar-${name}`; }
  function generateDefaultAvatar(name){
    const seed=hashString(name);
    const skinTones=["#f3c39c","#e6ad7d","#cf8f62","#a96b45","#75462f","#4b2d22"];
    const hairs=["#1f1615","#352119","#57331f","#7c4b25","#b87333","#1d2330","#4a2a4e"];
    const shirts=["#22d3c5","#6d55e8","#d54e7d","#3da6f0","#57b85c","#e6b938"];
    const skin=skinTones[seed%skinTones.length], hair=hairs[(seed>>>3)%hairs.length], shirt=shirts[(seed>>>6)%shirts.length];
    const eye=(seed&1)?"#244d68":"#3b271e";
    const px=Array(AVATAR_SIZE*AVATAR_SIZE).fill(AVATAR_BG);
    const set=(x,y,c)=>{ if(x>=0&&x<16&&y>=0&&y<16)px[y*16+x]=c; };
    const fill=(x1,y1,x2,y2,c)=>{for(let y=y1;y<=y2;y++)for(let x=x1;x<=x2;x++)set(x,y,c)};
    // white background is always filled
    fill(2,1,13,13,skin); fill(1,5,2,10,skin); fill(13,5,14,10,skin);
    // hair with deterministic fringe
    fill(2,1,13,4,hair); fill(2,4,4,6,hair); fill(11,4,13,6,hair);
    const fringe=(seed>>>9)%3;
    if(fringe===0){fill(5,4,7,5,hair)} else if(fringe===1){fill(8,4,10,5,hair)} else {fill(6,4,9,4,hair)};
    // eyes
    fill(4,7,6,8,"#ffffff"); fill(9,7,11,8,"#ffffff"); set(5,8,eye); set(10,8,eye);
    // nose / mouth shading
    set(7,9,"#b97555"); set(8,9,"#b97555"); fill(6,11,9,11,"#6f3e3e");
    // shirt / shoulders
    fill(3,14,12,15,shirt); fill(1,15,14,15,shirt); set(7,14,"#ece8ff"); set(8,14,"#ece8ff");
    return px;
  }
  function getAvatarPixels(name){
    try{const saved=localStorage.getItem(avatarStorageKey(name)); if(saved){const parsed=JSON.parse(saved);if(Array.isArray(parsed)&&parsed.length===256)return parsed;}}catch{}
    return generateDefaultAvatar(name);
  }
  function avatarDataUrlFromPixels(pixels){
    const canvas=document.createElement("canvas");canvas.width=16;canvas.height=16;
    const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");ctx.fillStyle=AVATAR_BG;ctx.fillRect(0,0,16,16);
    pixels.forEach((color,i)=>{ctx.fillStyle=color||AVATAR_BG;ctx.fillRect(i%16,Math.floor(i/16),1,1)});
    return canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
  }
  function avatarDataUrl(name){ return avatarDataUrlFromPixels(getAvatarPixels(name)); }
  function hslToHex(h,s,l){
    s/=100;l/=100;const k=n=>(n+h/30)%12;const a=s*Math.min(l,1-l);const f=n=>l-a*Math.max(-1,Math.min(k(n)-3,Math.min(9-k(n),1)));
    return `#${[f(0),f(8),f(4)].map(x=>Math.round(255*x).toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("")}`;
  }
  function avatarPalette(){
    const colors=["#000000","#171717","#303030","#555555","#7a7a7a","#a0a0a0","#c8c8c8","#ffffff","#f3c39c","#e6ad7d","#cf8f62","#a96b45","#75462f","#4b2d22"];
    for(let h=0;h<360;h+=30){colors.push(hslToHex(h,85,30),hslToHex(h,85,45),hslToHex(h,85,60),hslToHex(h,85,75));}
    return [...new Set(colors)];
  }

  }

  function renderPlacementTrack(done=7,animateLatest=false){
    const track=document.querySelector("#placementTrack");
    if(!track)return;
    let html="";
    for(let i=1;i<=15;i++){
      if(i>1){
        const connectorClass=i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)?"done":(animateLatest&&i===done?"arriving":"");
        html += `<span class="placement-connector ${connectorClass}"></span>`;
      }
      const nodeClass=i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)?"done":(animateLatest&&i===done?"arriving":"");
      const check=(i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)||i===done)?`<b>✓</b>`:"";
      html += `<span class="placement-node ${nodeClass}">${check}</span>`;
    }
    track.innerHTML=html;
  }

  function hashString(value){
    let h=2166136261;

  }
  function avatarStorageKey(name){ return `sg-hub-avatar-${name}`; }
  function generateDefaultAvatar(name){
    const seed=hashString(name);
    const skinTones=["#f3c39c","#e6ad7d","#cf8f62","#a96b45","#75462f","#4b2d22"];
    const hairs=["#1f1615","#352119","#57331f","#7c4b25","#b87333","#1d2330","#4a2a4e"];
    const shirts=["#22d3c5","#6d55e8","#d54e7d","#3da6f0","#57b85c","#e6b938"];
    const skin=skinTones[seed%skinTones.length], hair=hairs[(seed>>>3)%hairs.length], shirt=shirts[(seed>>>6)%shirts.length];
    const eye=(seed&1)?"#244d68":"#3b271e";
    const px=Array(AVATAR_SIZE*AVATAR_SIZE).fill(AVATAR_BG);
    const set=(x,y,c)=>{ if(x>=0&&x<16&&y>=0&&y<16)px[y*16+x]=c; };
    const fill=(x1,y1,x2,y2,c)=>{for(let y=y1;y<=y2;y++)for(let x=x1;x<=x2;x++)set(x,y,c)};
    // white background is always filled
    fill(2,1,13,13,skin); fill(1,5,2,10,skin); fill(13,5,14,10,skin);
    // hair with deterministic fringe
    fill(2,1,13,4,hair); fill(2,4,4,6,hair); fill(11,4,13,6,hair);
    const fringe=(seed>>>9)%3;
    if(fringe===0){fill(5,4,7,5,hair)} else if(fringe===1){fill(8,4,10,5,hair)} else {fill(6,4,9,4,hair)};
    // eyes
    fill(4,7,6,8,"#ffffff"); fill(9,7,11,8,"#ffffff"); set(5,8,eye); set(10,8,eye);
    // nose / mouth shading
    set(7,9,"#b97555"); set(8,9,"#b97555"); fill(6,11,9,11,"#6f3e3e");
    // shirt / shoulders
    fill(3,14,12,15,shirt); fill(1,15,14,15,shirt); set(7,14,"#ece8ff"); set(8,14,"#ece8ff");
    return px;
  }

  function hashString(value){
    let h=2166136261;
    for(const ch of value){h^=ch.charCodeAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619);}
    return h>>>0;
  }
  function avatarStorageKey(name){ return `sg-hub-avatar-${name}`; }
  function generateDefaultAvatar(name){
    const seed=hashString(name);
    const skinTones=["#f3c39c","#e6ad7d","#cf8f62","#a96b45","#75462f","#4b2d22"];
    const hairs=["#1f1615","#352119","#57331f","#7c4b25","#b87333","#1d2330","#4a2a4e"];
    const shirts=["#22d3c5","#6d55e8","#d54e7d","#3da6f0","#57b85c","#e6b938"];
    const skin=skinTones[seed%skinTones.length], hair=hairs[(seed>>>3)%hairs.length], shirt=shirts[(seed>>>6)%shirts.length];
    const eye=(seed&1)?"#244d68":"#3b271e";
    const px=Array(AVATAR_SIZE*AVATAR_SIZE).fill(AVATAR_BG);
    const set=(x,y,c)=>{ if(x>=0&&x<16&&y>=0&&y<16)px[y*16+x]=c; };
    const fill=(x1,y1,x2,y2,c)=>{for(let y=y1;y<=y2;y++)for(let x=x1;x<=x2;x++)set(x,y,c)};
    // white background is always filled
    fill(2,1,13,13,skin); fill(1,5,2,10,skin); fill(13,5,14,10,skin);
    // hair with deterministic fringe
    fill(2,1,13,4,hair); fill(2,4,4,6,hair); fill(11,4,13,6,hair);
    const fringe=(seed>>>9)%3;
    if(fringe===0){fill(5,4,7,5,hair)} else if(fringe===1){fill(8,4,10,5,hair)} else {fill(6,4,9,4,hair)};
    // eyes
    fill(4,7,6,8,"#ffffff"); fill(9,7,11,8,"#ffffff"); set(5,8,eye); set(10,8,eye);
    // nose / mouth shading
    set(7,9,"#b97555"); set(8,9,"#b97555"); fill(6,11,9,11,"#6f3e3e");
    // shirt / shoulders
    fill(3,14,12,15,shirt); fill(1,15,14,15,shirt); set(7,14,"#ece8ff"); set(8,14,"#ece8ff");
    return px;
  }
  function getAvatarPixels(name){
    try{const saved=localStorage.getItem(avatarStorageKey(name)); if(saved){const parsed=JSON.parse(saved);if(Array.isArray(parsed)&&parsed.length===256)return parsed;}}catch{}
    return generateDefaultAvatar(name);
  }
  function avatarDataUrlFromPixels(pixels){
    const canvas=document.createElement("canvas");canvas.width=16;canvas.height=16;
    const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");ctx.fillStyle=AVATAR_BG;ctx.fillRect(0,0,16,16);
    pixels.forEach((color,i)=>{ctx.fillStyle=color||AVATAR_BG;ctx.fillRect(i%16,Math.floor(i/16),1,1)});
    return canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
  }
  function avatarDataUrl(name){ return avatarDataUrlFromPixels(getAvatarPixels(name)); }
  function hslToHex(h,s,l){
    s/=100;l/=100;const k=n=>(n+h/30)%12;const a=s*Math.min(l,1-l);const f=n=>l-a*Math.max(-1,Math.min(k(n)-3,Math.min(9-k(n),1)));
    return `#${[f(0),f(8),f(4)].map(x=>Math.round(255*x).toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("")}`;
  }
  function avatarPalette(){
    const colors=["#000000","#171717","#303030","#555555","#7a7a7a","#a0a0a0","#c8c8c8","#ffffff","#f3c39c","#e6ad7d","#cf8f62","#a96b45","#75462f","#4b2d22"];
    for(let h=0;h<360;h+=30){colors.push(hslToHex(h,85,30),hslToHex(h,85,45),hslToHex(h,85,60),hslToHex(h,85,75));}
    return [...new Set(colors)];
  }

  function renderPlacementTrack(done=7,animateLatest=false){
    const track=document.querySelector("#placementTrack");
    if(!track)return;
    let html="";
    for(let i=1;i<=15;i++){
      if(i>1){
        const connectorClass=i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)?"done":(animateLatest&&i===done?"arriving":"");
        html += `<span class="placement-connector ${connectorClass}"></span>`;
      }
      const nodeClass=i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)?"done":(animateLatest&&i===done?"arriving":"");
      const check=(i<done||(!animateLatest&&i<=done)||i===done)?`<b>✓</b>`:"";
      html += `<span class="placement-node ${nodeClass}">${check}</span>`;
    }
    track.innerHTML=html;
  }

  function generateDefaultAvatar(name){
    const seed=hashString(name);
    const skinTones=["#f3c39c","#e6ad7d","#cf8f62","#a96b45","#75462f","#4b2d22"];
    const hairs=["#1f1615","#352119","#57331f","#7c4b25","#b87333","#1d2330","#4a2a4e"];
    const shirts=["#22d3c5","#6d55e8","#d54e7d","#3da6f0","#57b85c","#e6b938"];
    const skin=skinTones[seed%skinTones.length], hair=hairs[(seed>>>3)%hairs.length], shirt=shirts[(seed>>>6)%shirts.length];
    const eye=(seed&1)?"#244d68":"#3b271e";
    const px=Array(AVATAR_SIZE*AVATAR_SIZE).fill(AVATAR_BG);
    const set=(x,y,c)=>{ if(x>=0&&x<16&&y>=0&&y<16)px[y*16+x]=c; };
    const fill=(x1,y1,x2,y2,c)=>{for(let y=y1;y<=y2;y++)for(let x=x1;x<=x2;x++)set(x,y,c)};
    // white background is always filled
    fill(2,1,13,13,skin); fill(1,5,2,10,skin); fill(13,5,14,10,skin);
    // hair with deterministic fringe
    fill(2,1,13,4,hair); fill(2,4,4,6,hair); fill(11,4,13,6,hair);
    const fringe=(seed>>>9)%3;
    if(fringe===0){fill(5,4,7,5,hair)} else if(fringe===1){fill(8,4,10,5,hair)} else {fill(6,4,9,4,hair)};
    // eyes
    fill(4,7,6,8,"#ffffff"); fill(9,7,11,8,"#ffffff"); set(5,8,eye); set(10,8,eye);
    // nose / mouth shading
    set(7,9,"#b97555"); set(8,9,"#b97555"); fill(6,11,9,11,"#6f3e3e");
    // shirt / shoulders
    fill(3,14,12,15,shirt); fill(1,15,14,15,shirt); set(7,14,"#ece8ff"); set(8,14,"#ece8ff");
    return px;
  }
